versos.grego: Καὶ τῷ ἀγγέλῳ τῆς ἐν Σάρδεσιν ἐκκλησίας γράψον Τάδε λέγει ὁ ἔχων τὰ ἑπτὰ Πνεύματα τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ τοὺς ἑπτὰ ἀστέρας Οἶδά σου τὰ ἔργα, ὅτι ὄνομα ἔχεις ὅτι ζῇς, καὶ νεκρὸς εἶ.

controles.web: “And to the angel of the assembly in Sardis write:   “He who has the seven Spirits of God, and the seven stars says these things:   “I know your works, that you have a reputation of being alive, but you are dead.
controles.kjv: And unto the angel of the church in Sardis write; These things saith he that hath the seven Spirits of God, and the seven stars; I know thy works, that thou hast a name that thou livest, and art dead.
controles.livre: E escreve ao anjo da igreja que está em Sardes: Isto diz aquele que tem os sete espíritos de Deus, e as sete estrelas: Eu conheço tuas obras; que tu tens nome de que vives, e estás morto.

versos.grego: γίνου γρηγορῶν, καὶ στήρισον τὰ λοιπὰ ἃ ἔμελλον ἀποθανεῖν· οὐ γὰρ εὕρηκά σου ἔργα πεπληρωμένα ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ μου·

controles.web: Wake up, and keep the things that remain, which you were about to throw away, for I have found no works of yours perfected before my God.
controles.kjv: Be watchful, and strengthen the things which remain, that are ready to die: for I have not found thy works perfect before God.
controles.livre: Sê vigilante, e firma o resto que está a ponto de morrer; porque eu não achei tuas obras completas diante de Deus.

versos.grego: μνημόνευε οὖν πῶς εἴληφας καὶ ἤκουσας, καὶ τήρει καὶ μετανόησον. ἐὰν οὖν μὴ γρηγορήσῃς, ἥξω ὡς κλέπτης, καὶ οὐ μὴ γνῷς ποίαν ὥραν ἥξω ἐπὶ σέ.

controles.web: Remember therefore how you have received and heard. Keep it, and repent. If therefore you won’t watch, I will come as a thief, and you won’t know what hour I will come upon you.
controles.kjv: Remember therefore how thou hast received and heard, and hold fast, and repent. If therefore thou shalt not watch, I will come on thee as a thief, and thou shalt not know what hour I will come upon thee.
controles.livre: Então lembra-te do que tu tens recebido e ouvido, e guarda, e arrepende-te. Portanto, se tu não vigiares, eu virei sobre ti como ladrão, e tu não saberás a que hora eu virei sobre ti.

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ ἔχεις ὀλίγα ὀνόματα ἐν Σάρδεσιν ἃ οὐκ ἐμόλυναν τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτῶν, καὶ περιπατήσουσιν μετ’ ἐμοῦ ἐν λευκοῖς, ὅτι ἄξιοί εἰσιν.

controles.web: Nevertheless you have a few names in Sardis that did not defile their garments. They will walk with me in white, for they are worthy.
controles.kjv: Thou hast a few names even in Sardis which have not defiled their garments; and they shall walk with me in white: for they are worthy.
controles.livre: Mas também em Sardo tu tens alguns poucos nomes, ou seja, pessoas que não contaminaram suas roupas, e andarão comigo em roupas brancas, porque são dignos.

versos.grego: Ὁ νικῶν οὕτως περιβαλεῖται ἐν ἱματίοις λευκοῖς, καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐξαλείψω τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐκ τῆς βίβλου τῆς ζωῆς, καὶ ὁμολογήσω τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐνώπιον τοῦ Πατρός μου καὶ ἐνώπιον τῶν ἀγγέλων αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: He who overcomes will be arrayed in white garments, and I will in no way blot his name out of the book of life, and I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.
controles.kjv: He that overcometh, the same shall be clothed in white raiment; and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life, but I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.
controles.livre: O que vencer, este será vestido de roupas brancas; e seu nome em maneira nenhuma riscarei do livro da vida; e eu declararei seu nome diante do meu Pai, e diante de seus anjos.

versos.grego: Ὁ ἔχων οὖς ἀκουσάτω τί τὸ Πνεῦμα λέγει ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις.

controles.web: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.
controles.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
controles.livre: Quem tem ouvidos, ouça o que o Espírito diz às igrejas.

versos.grego: Καὶ τῷ ἀγγέλῳ τῆς ἐν Φιλαδελφίᾳ ἐκκλησίας γράψον Τάδε λέγει ὁ ἅγιος, ὁ ἀληθινός, ὁ ἔχων τὴν κλεῖν Δαυείδ, ὁ ἀνοίγων καὶ οὐδεὶς κλείσει, καὶ κλείων καὶ οὐδεὶς ἀνοίγει

controles.web: “To the angel of the assembly in Philadelphia write:   “He who is holy, he who is true, he who has the key of David, he who opens and no one can shut, and who shuts and no one opens, says these things:
controles.kjv: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write; These things saith he that is holy, he that is true, he that hath the key of David, he that openeth, and no man shutteth; and shutteth, and no man openeth;
controles.livre: E escreve ao anjo da igreja que está em Filadélfia: Isto diz o Santo, o Verdadeiro, que tem a chave de Davi; que abre e ninguém fecha; que fecha e ninguém abre;

versos.grego: Οἶδά σου τὰ ἔργα· ἰδοὺ δέδωκα ἐνώπιόν σου θύραν ἠνεῳγμένην, ἣν οὐδεὶς δύναται κλεῖσαι αὐτήν· ὅτι μικρὰν ἔχεις δύναμιν, καὶ ἐτήρησάς μου τὸν λόγον καὶ οὐκ ἠρνήσω τὸ ὄνομά μου.

controles.web: “I know your works (behold, I have set before you an open door, which no one can shut), that you have a little power, and kept my word, and didn’t deny my name.
controles.kjv: I know thy works: behold, I have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it: for thou hast a little strength, and hast kept my word, and hast not denied my name.
controles.livre: Eu conheço as tuas obras; eis que eu te dei diante de ti uma porta aberta, e ninguém a pode fechar; porque tu tens pouca força, e guardaste minha palavra, e não negaste o meu nome.

versos.grego: ἰδοὺ διδῶ ἐκ τῆς συναγωγῆς τοῦ Σατανᾶ, τῶν λεγόντων ἑαυτοὺς Ἰουδαίους εἶναι, καὶ οὐκ εἰσὶν ἀλλὰ ψεύδονται· ἰδοὺ ποιήσω αὐτοὺς ἵνα ἥξουσιν καὶ προσκυνήσουσιν ἐνώπιον τῶν ποδῶν σου, καὶ γνῶσιν ὅτι ἐγὼ ἠγάπησά σε.

controles.web: Behold, I give of the synagogue of Satan, of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but lie. Behold, I will make them to come and worship before your feet, and to know that I have loved you.
controles.kjv: Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet, and to know that I have loved thee.
controles.livre: Eis que eu entrego alguns da sinagoga de Satanás, dos que dizem ser judeus, e não são, mas mentem; eis que eu farei com que venham, e fiquem prostrados diante dos teus pés, e saibam que eu te amo;

versos.grego: ὅτι ἐτήρησας τὸν λόγον τῆς ὑπομονῆς μου, κἀγώ σε τηρήσω ἐκ τῆς ὥρας τοῦ πειρασμοῦ τῆς μελλούσης ἔρχεσθαι ἐπὶ τῆς οἰκουμένης ὅλης, πειράσαι τοὺς κατοικοῦντας ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς.

controles.web: Because you kept my command to endure, I also will keep you from the hour of testing, which is to come on the whole world, to test those who dwell on the earth.
controles.kjv: Because thou hast kept the word of my patience, I also will keep thee from the hour of temptation, which shall come upon all the world, to try them that dwell upon the earth.
controles.livre: Porque tu guardaste a palavra da minha paciência, também eu te guardarei da hora da provação que está para vir sobre todo o mundo, para testar aos que habitam sobre a terra.

versos.grego: ἔρχομαι ταχύ· κράτει ὃ ἔχεις, ἵνα μηδεὶς λάβῃ τὸν στέφανόν σου.

controles.web: I am coming quickly! Hold firmly that which you have, so that no one takes your crown.
controles.kjv: Behold, I come quickly: hold that fast which thou hast, that no man take thy crown.
controles.livre: Eis que eu venho em breve; guarda o que tu tens, para que ninguém tome tua coroa.

versos.grego: Ὁ νικῶν, ποιήσω αὐτὸν στῦλον ἐν τῷ ναῷ τοῦ Θεοῦ μου, καὶ ἔξω οὐ μὴ ἐξέλθῃ ἔτι, καὶ γράψω ἐπ’ αὐτὸν τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ Θεοῦ μου καὶ τὸ ὄνομα τῆς πόλεως τοῦ Θεοῦ μου, τῆς καινῆς Ἱερουσαλὴμ ἡ καταβαίνουσα ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἀπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ μου, καὶ τὸ ὄνομά μου τὸ καινόν.

controles.web: He who overcomes, I will make him a pillar in the temple of my God, and he will go out from there no more. I will write on him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from my God, and my own new name.
controles.kjv: Him that overcometh will I make a pillar in the temple of my God, and he shall go no more out: and I will write upon him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, which is new Jerusalem, which cometh down out of heaven from my God: and I will write upon him my new name.
controles.livre: Ao que vencer, eu o farei coluna no templo do meu Deus; e dele nunca mais sairá; e sobre ele escreverei o nome do meu Deus, e o nome da cidade do meu Deus, Nova Jerusalém, que desce do céu do meu Deus, e também meu novo nome.

versos.grego: Ὁ ἔχων οὖς ἀκουσάτω τί τὸ Πνεῦμα λέγει ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις.

controles.web: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.
controles.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
controles.livre: Quem tem ouvidos, ouça o que o Espírito diz às igrejas.

versos.grego: Καὶ τῷ ἀγγέλῳ τῆς ἐν Λαοδικίᾳ ἐκκλησίας γράψον Τάδε λέγει ὁ Ἀμήν, ὁ μάρτυς ὁ πιστὸς καὶ ἀληθινός, ἡ ἀρχὴ τῆς κτίσεως τοῦ Θεοῦ

controles.web: “To the angel of the assembly in Laodicea write:   “The Amen, the Faithful and True Witness, the Head of God’s creation, says these things:
controles.kjv: And unto the angel of the church of the Laodiceans write; These things saith the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of the creation of God;
controles.livre: E escreve ao anjo da igreja dos laodicenses: Isto diz o Amém, a testemunha fiel e verdadeira, o principal da criação de Deus;

versos.grego: Οἶδά σου τὰ ἔργα, ὅτι οὔτε ψυχρὸς εἶ οὔτε ζεστός. ὄφελον ψυχρὸς ἦς ἢ ζεστός.

controles.web: “I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were cold or hot.
controles.kjv: I know thy works, that thou art neither cold nor hot: I would thou wert cold or hot.
controles.livre: Eu conheço as tuas obras, que tu nem és frio, nem quente; melhor seria que tu fosses frio ou quente!

versos.grego: οὕτως, ὅτι χλιαρὸς εἶ, καὶ οὔτε ζεστὸς οὔτε ψυχρός, μέλλω σε ἐμέσαι ἐκ τοῦ στόματός μου.

controles.web: So, because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will vomit you out of my mouth.
controles.kjv: So then because thou art lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will spue thee out of my mouth.
controles.livre: Portanto porque tu és morno, e nem frio nem quente, eu te vomitarei da minha boca.

versos.grego: ὅτι λέγεις ὅτι Πλούσιός εἰμι καὶ πεπλούτηκα καὶ οὐδὲν χρείαν ἔχω, καὶ οὐκ οἶδας ὅτι σὺ εἶ ὁ ταλαίπωρος καὶ ἐλεεινὸς καὶ πτωχὸς καὶ τυφλὸς καὶ γυμνός,

controles.web: Because you say, ‘I am rich, and have gotten riches, and have need of nothing;’ and don’t know that you are the wretched one, miserable, poor, blind, and naked;
controles.kjv: Because thou sayest, I am rich, and increased with goods, and have need of nothing; and knowest not that thou art wretched, and miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked:
controles.livre: Porque tu dizes: Eu sou rico, e tenho me enriquecido, e de nada tenho falta; E não sabes que estás miserável, coitado, pobre, cego e nu.

versos.grego: συμβουλεύω σοι ἀγοράσαι παρ’ ἐμοῦ χρυσίον πεπυρωμένον ἐκ πυρὸς ἵνα πλουτήσῃς, καὶ ἱμάτια λευκὰ ἵνα περιβάλῃ καὶ μὴ φανερωθῇ ἡ αἰσχύνη τῆς γυμνότητός σου, καὶ κολλούριον ἐγχρῖσαι τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς σου ἵνα βλέπῃς.

controles.web: I counsel you to buy from me gold refined by fire, that you may become rich; and white garments, that you may clothe yourself, and that the shame of your nakedness may not be revealed; and eye salve to anoint your eyes, that you may see.
controles.kjv: I counsel thee to buy of me gold tried in the fire, that thou mayest be rich; and white raiment, that thou mayest be clothed, and that the shame of thy nakedness do not appear; and anoint thine eyes with eyesalve, that thou mayest see.
controles.livre: Eu te aconselho a comprar de mim ouro provado do fogo, para que te enriqueças; e roupas brancas, para que te vistas; e a vergonha de tua nudez não apareça; e unge teus olhos com colírio, para que vejas.

versos.grego: ἐγὼ ὅσους ἐὰν φιλῶ ἐλέγχω καὶ παιδεύω· ζήλευε οὖν καὶ μετανόησον.

controles.web: As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent.
controles.kjv: As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten: be zealous therefore, and repent.
controles.livre: Eu repreendo e castigo a todos quantos eu amo; portanto sê zeloso, e te arrepende.

versos.grego: Ἰδοὺ ἕστηκα ἐπὶ τὴν θύραν καὶ κρούω· ἐάν τις ἀκούσῃ τῆς φωνῆς μου καὶ ἀνοίξῃ τὴν θύραν, εἰσελεύσομαι πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ δειπνήσω μετ’ αὐτοῦ καὶ αὐτὸς μετ’ ἐμοῦ.

controles.web: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him, and will dine with him, and he with me.
controles.kjv: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.
controles.livre: Eis que eu estou à porta, e bato; se alguém ouvir a minha voz, e abrir a porta, entrarei até ele, e cearei com ele, e ele comigo.

versos.grego: Ὁ νικῶν δώσω αὐτῷ καθίσαι μετ’ ἐμοῦ ἐν τῷ θρόνῳ μου, ὡς κἀγὼ ἐνίκησα καὶ ἐκάθισα μετὰ τοῦ Πατρός μου ἐν τῷ θρόνῳ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: He who overcomes, I will give to him to sit down with me on my throne, as I also overcame, and sat down with my Father on his throne.
controles.kjv: To him that overcometh will I grant to sit with me in my throne, even as I also overcame, and am set down with my Father in his throne.
controles.livre: Ao que vencer, eu lhe concederei que se sente comigo em meu trono; assim como eu também venci, e me sentei com meu Pai no trono dele.

versos.grego: Ὁ ἔχων οὖς ἀκουσάτω τί τὸ Πνεῦμα λέγει ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις.

controles.web: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.”
controles.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
controles.livre: Quem tem ouvidos, ouça o que o Espírito diz às igrejas.
